coupled_oscillator_audit.finding: The coupled oscillator equation proposed in PDF B Section 5.2 (x_i'' + f_i^2 x_i = sum K(|f_i - f_j|)(x_j - x_i)) exhibits normal-mode level repulsion for K > 0: the frequency difference INCREASES from 0.500 to 0.536 at K=0.6, producing emergent-space repulsion rather than attraction. Reversing the sign (K < 0) causes tachyonic runaway instability whenever |K| exceeds |K_crit| = 2.4390.

linear_wave_superposition_audit.finding: Linear superposition W_1 + W_2 of two wave entities produces amplitude beating at |f_2 - f_1| = 2.00 Hz in intensity I(r,t), but ZERO shift in the entities' spectral frequencies (Delta f_1 = 0.00e+00, Delta f_2 = 0.00e+00).
